cells.tense: You are standing in the yield now, with the pen still in your hand.
cells.act: do the fair thing where no one will see
cells.ask: Find a spot where being fair costs you and nobody would know if you skipped it. Do it anyway, and don't mention it.
cells.core:
What patience and slow change grew is out where you can see it — the structure held, the plan ran, the thing you kept tending finally shows real weight. That is the good version and you are standing in it. Setting order into that yield, a clean rule, a plain reply among your people, is where your hands belong this season.

Your quiet sense of what is fair has a turn coming up. Don't price it or run a tally. Settle what you owe before anyone has to bring it up. Do the right thing where no one is watching, and skip the count on the other side. Then get back to what is actually yours to do.

cells.verb: gathering what slow change finally grew
cells.place: where pattern and structure get established

cells.tense: You are already raising the structure over a harvest that hasn't landed.
cells.act: rest in the connection without doing anything with it
cells.ask: Sit with one person the plan touches. No agenda, no fix, nothing to decide. Then take the step.
cells.core:
You are pitching the frame — five moves, what each covers, who reports to whom — over ground that has not finished growing. The energy is real; the timing is early. This goes well when the frame goes up only after the yield has shown, and the frame then serves what it holds. Right now the frame is going up over a field that hasn't finished, and the people under it can hear hammering.

Sit with one person the plan touches. No agenda, no fix, no plan to hand them. Rest in it. The structure you raise after that goes up over ground that has actually produced something, and it will hold.

cells.tense: The structure you keep meaning to raise is still not up.
cells.act: let the will and the wanting go the same way
cells.ask: Take the piece you keep avoiding, say what you actually want from it, then build the version you'd build even without that.
cells.core:
You have been standing where the pattern gets set and nothing is being set. The momentum dried up somewhere — you don't have to say where — and now every attempt needs a spur. This goes well when the structure rises at a pace your energy can actually feed, and when what you will and what you want pull in the same direction. Right now you are asking of yourself the pace of one good day, which is why nothing rises.

Take the piece you keep avoiding and say what you actually want from it. Then build the version you would build even without that pull. The fair payoff came slower than anyone promised. Start where the ground gives.

cells.tense: You have been setting the order of things while saying you only kept up.
cells.act: declare the shape of it outward, plainly
cells.ask: Say the shape of one shared arrangement out loud to the people it touches — plain words, once, no argument after.
cells.core:
Somewhere in the last stretch you started setting how a shared thing runs — the order, who covers what, the quiet rules nobody voted on — and you have kept describing it as land you found and merely stepped into. The setting was yours, and it went unsigned. This goes well when things make sense where you are because you built the sense, and you are free to say so out loud.

Say the shape to the people it touches. One arrangement, plain words, once. Skip the argument after. The order then sits where they can see it instead of being carried around in the body and spoken by nobody.
